configurationFields.label: Server Key
configurationFields.description: Sets the [server key](https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys) required to run the server. This also sets the server name. A Plutonium account must be at least one week old to create a key, and game ownership must be [verified](https://forum.plutonium.pw/topic/32250/an-update-on-game-ownership-verification)

configurationFields.label: Server MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom message of the day which is shown on the intel message loading screen when a player joins. Leave blank for default intel messages

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Mod Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the mod name to load

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation List
configurationFields.description: Sets the map rotation list. See 'server.cfg' for gametypes and map names
configurationFields.default: dsr TDM_default map mp_rust map mp_terminal_cls map mp_alpha map mp_bootleg map mp_bravo map mp_carbon map mp_dome map mp_exchange map mp_hardhat map mp_interchange map mp_lambeth map mp_mogadishu map mp_paris map mp_plaza2 map mp_radar map mp_seatown map mp_underground map mp_village
configurationFields.placeholder: dsr TDM_default map mp_rust map mp_terminal_cls map mp_alpha map mp_bootleg map mp_bravo map mp_carbon map mp_dome map mp_exchange map mp_hardhat map mp_interchange map mp_lambeth map mp_mogadishu map mp_paris map mp_plaza2 map mp_radar map mp_seatown map mp_underground map mp_village

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Private Player Limit
configurationFields.description: The maximum number of private players allowed on the server (those that can use non-public reserved slots). Will be limited to the Player Limit

configurationFields.label: Private Player Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for private players to join the server. Private players entering this password have access to all slots on the server, otherwise the players only have access to the public slots (Player Limit less Private Player Limit)

configurationFields.label: Enable Pure Server
configurationFields.description: If set, client files will be verified to ensure integrity and prevent cheating

configurationFields.label: Connection Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the connection timeout period. Players will timeout after this duration when attempting to connect or experiencing connection interruptions

configurationFields.label: Reconnection Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of times a player can attempt to reconnect to the server

configurationFields.label: Fast Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the base URL for [fast download](https://plutonium.pw/docs/server/iw5/fastdl/) of mods

configurationFields.label: RCON Rate Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the RCON rate limit (per IP). Localhost RCON commands are not rate limited

configurationFields.label: Server Say Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name that server-side 'say' commands show up as. Colour tags are supported

configurationFields.label: Allow Client Console
configurationFields.description: If set, players have access to server commands through their client console

configurationFields.label: Enable Flood Protection
configurationFields.description: If enabled, flood protection applies, so user commands are throttled. Should be enabled on non-password-protected public servers

configurationFields.label: Enable Voting
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting is allowed for player kick, map restart and next map

configurationFields.label: Inactivity Kick Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time before the server will kick a player for inactivity

configurationFields.label: Temporary Ban Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time for a player temporary ban (on kick/tempban)

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the server voice chat mode

configurationFields.label: Server Voice Chat Quality
configurationFields.description: Sets the server voice quality level

configurationFields.label: Enable Dead Chat
configurationFields.description: If enabled, dead players will be allowed to chat with living players

configurationFields.label: Allow Aim Assist
configurationFields.description: If set, Aim Assist will be allowed on gamepads

configurationFields.label: Player Collision Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whom player collision applies to

configurationFields.label: Player Ejection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whom player ejection applies to

configurationFields.label: Enable Team Balance
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be automatically balanced between teams in team-based games for fair play

configurationFields.label: Enable Bounces
configurationFields.description: If set, bouncing mechanics will be allowed on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Double Taps
configurationFields.description: If set, double tap functionality will be allowed on weapon switching

configurationFields.label: Allow Third Person Spectator
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to spectate players in third-person view

deploymentSteps.name: Disable Prefix Sound
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd call-of-dutymw3 && wget -q -N https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Winetricks/winetricks/master/src/winetricks && chmod +x winetricks; export WINEPREFIX=\"{SERVER_DIR}/.wine\"; export WINEARCH=win32; ./winetricks sound=disabled > winescript_log.txt 2>&1"

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
